population: Release attempt 5's 58 verification tasks (CORPUS-8 61 to 300; development data since attempt 5 closed), reasoning answers unchanged, verification re-run by blind subagents with the W2 verifier brief; scored against attempt 5's existing labels (docs/evaluation/runs/attempt5-2026-10).
codeUnderTest: P3 (open by design), E5 (filler keys), W1, W3 and the W2 verifier: an effectHolds check (yes, no or unsure) and a 0 to 1 confidence on every verdict; a confirmed verdict whose effectHolds is no is not admitted.
withdrawn: A first version also asked otherAccounts. On 3 of the first batches it moved one repository's three findings (both labelers: real) to unverified because the app has a single operator. Removed and every batch re-run with the final brief.
effectHoldsGate: Never fired: no confirmed verdict answered effectHolds no. Its effect was the wording: c8-lovr's delete now states the restrict relations that block it.
trueLost: All 7 were verifier variance (unverified with unsure), not the gate: c8-crm 5, c8-memento-academy 2, c8-lovr 1.

confidenceCalibration.decision: The agent's own confidence barely separates true from false; no threshold is set on it. Recorded on every verification task for calibration; a calibrated judge (JEV) is the candidate to close this.

notARelease: Development data on an attempt already seen. Only a fresh frozen run (attempt 6) is a release number.
